body:
## Reading the Sector Q plan

### A curved perimeter and central grid

Sector Q has a curved lower perimeter around a central street grid, with a separate band of plots and roads toward the top of the plan. Ask whether your shortlisted plot sits in the central grid or nearer the curved edge, and compare the actual access route on the map.

Use the plan to shortlist a location and arrange a visit to see its current condition.

## What to request for a Sector Q shortlist

Ask for an available plot number marked on this sector's plan, its size and dimensions, road position and a current location pin. Request a recent photograph or live walkthrough of that same location, rather than a general Phase 2 promotional image.

## Full-payment price comparison

Our listed Sector Q inventory starts at 8 Marla. Use the price table as a reference and confirm stock and the final payable amount. Compare the exact location and any dues or premiums when reviewing another sector.

## Verification before payment

Confirm the seller, plot details, total dues, recipient and receipt procedure. The [master-plan buyer checklist](/articles/faisal-town-ii-master-plan/#before-making-any-payment) covers the common checks. Request current plot details and relevant documents for your shortlist.
